TTMI should be retained as the strongest US-listed underfollowed candidate for AI advanced PCB/interconnect exposure adjacent to ABF substrate constraints.

The direct ABF substrate leaders are mostly Japan/Taiwan-listed or OTC, so the US-listed direct-exposure set is mostly adjacent: AI accelerator customers, advanced PCB/interconnect manufacturers, advanced packaging users, and process-equipment suppliers for HDI/IC-substrate manufacturing. Reference anchor: NVIDIA as the dominant AI accelerator demand source.
